data.current_description:
Same service as the app: timeline entries, amendments, Slack message of an amendment confirmed by hand, `quote.status_changed` webhook.
`accepted` and `signed` are exclusive per event: when another live contract (accepted, signed, invoiced, paid) exists and `force_confirm` is false, nothing is written and the answer is `200` with `success: false`, `conflict: EXISTING_ACCEPTED_QUOTES` and the competing quotes. Call again with `force_confirm: true`: competing `accepted` quotes go back to `pending`; `signed`, `invoiced` and `paid` ones stay and their amounts add up.
A platform quote (`source: platform`) only takes `accepted` or `rejected`; anything else, or a live contract next to it, is a `409` that `force_confirm` does not lift. `invoiced`, `paid` and `cancelled` are set by invoicing and `POST /quotes/{id}/cancel`. **Role permission:** `quotes.manage`.

data.description_suggestion: Transitions a quote to a new status (pending, accepted, signed, rejected, invoiced, paid, or cancelled). Creates timeline entries, amendments, and fires `quote.status_changed` webhook. Enforces business rules: `accepted` and `signed` are mutually exclusive per event. When a competing live contract exists and `force_confirm=false`, returns `200` with `success: false` and lists conflicting quotes; retry with `force_confirm=true` to demote competing `accepted` quotes to `pending` (signed/invoiced/paid quotes remain). Platform quotes only accept `accepted` or `rejected` statuses. Invoiced, paid, and cancelled statuses are set by external systems or `POST /quotes/{id}/cancel`. Requires `quotes.manage` permission.

data.current_description: Option and confirmed (non-archived) events that would collide with a booking of this venue over the date window. An event occupies the spaces it books, or the whole venue when it books none (or when the venue is only rented whole); two events collide when their dates overlap and so do their footprints. Pass `space_ids` to check a booking of some spaces only; without it the check is for the whole venue, so every event of the venue in the window is returned. `venueId` may be a space: the check then runs on its venue for that space. Dates are calendar days of the venue's own time zone. A combined space (e.g. Salon AB = Salon A + Salon B, see `combined_space_ids`) takes its parts: it collides with each part and with any combination sharing one, while two parts do not collide with each other. A space's set-up / tear-down minutes widen each of its slots, and a slot running past midnight (22:00 → 02:00) still holds the next morning. The response also lists the venue's closures on those days (and those of the requested spaces) and the days it does not open (`outside_hours`), with its enforcement mode. **Role permission:** none (any member).
data.summary_suggestion: Check venue availability for date range
data.description_suggestion: Identifies conflicting events and venue unavailability for a proposed booking. Returns option and confirmed (non-archived) events that overlap with the specified date window and space(s), plus venue closures and hours outside operating times. Pass `space_ids` to check specific spaces; omit to check the entire venue. Handles combined spaces, setup/teardown times, and midnight-crossing slots. Dates are in the venue's timezone. **Role permission:** none (any member).
